what.text: This page follows Venezuelans in Guyana whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 23401 people in this group in Guyana, 0.4% of all Venezuelans in it.
The largest numbers of Venezuelan refugees live in Spain, Brazil, the United States and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Venezuela, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data run from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR has counted this group only since 2018, when the figure was at its highest, 36400.
It was lower by the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Guyana.
These are year-end totals for Guyana only, and the group is never added to refugees.
